aboutPage.title: About Us - Happy Wu
aboutPage.description: Happy Wu is a personal column sharing life, observations and ideas.
aboutPage.story: I write Happy Wu. This site is where I organise my thinking: everyday observations, books I have read and projects I have worked on, slowly turned into articles.
aboutPage.quote: "It only counts as thinking once it is written down."
aboutPage.siteOrigin: At first I just wanted somewhere to keep my notes. Then I noticed that writing in public forces me to think clearly, and lets like-minded people find each other. That is how this column began.
aboutPage.mission: No quick answers here, just carefully organised thoughts. Topics cover everyday observation, reading notes and ways of working, with the aim of building a knowledge base worth returning to.
aboutPage.exploreDescription: If you are interested in what you read here, or would like to exchange ideas, please reach out through the contact page.
